  - "Unlimited Members and Missing-Box Fees": Unlimited Standard Annual, status active (find_pass_memberships). Whether the plan covers return labels is read from the Unlimited Benefits Matrix: "Unlimited Standard Annual | Return method fee waived: No" and footnote "A free return label is the waiver of the return method fee on a return; only Unlimited Express Monthly, Unlimited Express Annual and Unlimited Next-Day Annual carry it" -> "active, plan does not cover return labels: 0.5 of the booked missing-box fee" -> box-fee part = 5.00.
  - Fee part = 15.00 + 5.00 = 20.00.
  - "Fees Absorbed When Inspection Is Posted Late": received 2026-09-18, inspected 2026-09-30 -> 12 calendar days -> "More than 7 but at most 14: 0.5" -> 20.00 − 10.00 = 10.00.
  - "Member Treatment of Fees in Store Credit Recoveries": Gold; earning postings for dispatched orders dated after 2025-10-06: 2025-11-21, 2026-02-10, 2026-05-12, 2026-08-25, 2026-09-18 = 5 (>=3) -> "Silver or Gold, 3 or more: × 0.75, rounded up to the cent" -> 7.50. (Doc text: "once any absorbed share is taken off" fixes absorption before treatment.)
  - "First-Recovery Allowance": lines inspected rejected/accepted-with-fee on OTHER returns in last 24 months: return 68b439d0 line `accepted` -> none -> allowance 5.00, "taken off the rejected part plus the fee part … before the limit to the store credit's current balance".
  - Total = 48.88 + 7.50 − 5.00 = 51.38; current balance 60.31 does not bind; rounding no effect. **Recovery = 51.38.**
- Composition judgement: the restocking cap and the box-fee benefit act on the two components the baseline names ("restocking part", "box-fee part"); the absorbed share acts on their sum ("the fee part"); the member treatment acts "once any absorbed share is taken off"; the allowance acts on rejected+fee before the balance limit. The component-then-sum order is not stated in one sentence but is the only reading consistent with the baseline's definitions.
- Fall-back (baseline only): 48.88 + (22.20 + 10.00) = 81.08 > 60.31 -> recovery 60.31 (credit emptied, nothing left to cash out). Definite and different.

**(b) Cash-out amount after the clawback (balance 8.93 on 2026-10-06)**
- Threshold: 8.93 is "Below 10.00" (CA) -> eligible.
- Refunded value: 6.00 (refund 2026-09-30 from order e3be162c, which the credit paid).
- Refund availability period: baseline 12 days. "Refund Availability Periods" (Rewards standing): Gold, enrolled 2020-11-03 -> 70+ whole months >= 36 -> 7 calendar days. "Delivery-Claim Record and the Refund Availability Period": no compensation issued in last 24 months (claim denied, no claim events) -> "shortened by 1 day" -> 6 days. Day 0 = 2026-09-30; 2026-10-06 is day 6 -> "payable on the day the count reaches the refund availability period" -> held refunded value = 0.00.

- Closest alternative recovery: 60.31/81.08 (baseline) — excluded by the five recovery factor docs whose tiers the records fix.
- Closest alternative clawback reason: `qualifying_purchase_refunded` — only for Bonus Gift Cards; return-caused clawback passes `order_id ""`.
- Factor findability (words of the records that led to each doc): Marlowe Rewards Gold + enrolled_date (refund availability standing; restocking cap; fee member treatment), delivery claim denied / no claim events (claim-record refund availability), `locked_date` on the credit + the customer's own mention of the September lock (lock reserve), return status `inspected` (settlement hold), order capture `rewards_note` (promotional exclusion), received/inspected dates on the return (late absorption), `returns_fee_assessed missing_box_fee` + Unlimited Standard Annual (box fee), other return's inspection outcome (first-recovery allowance).
